description: Structured list of human capabilities available to AI agents, automation systems, and developers. Submit tasks at POST /api/v1/tasks or via the MCP server at /mcp.
unlisted_tasks: This catalog is examples, not limits. Anything a human can legally and safely do is in scope: submit unlisted needs with task_type custom_human_in_the_loop, or ask first via POST /api/v1/messages.

capabilities.name: Real-world verification
capabilities.description: Confirm that a place, product, price, business, or claim exists and matches its description, with photo or text evidence.
example_tasks: Verify whether a specific product exists in a local store and photograph the shelf price.
Confirm a business at a given address is open and operating.
limitations: Physical checks depend on location coverage, confirmed at review.

capabilities.name: Product or app testing
capabilities.description: Install, use, and test software, apps, or physical products as a real human user and report findings.
example_tasks: Complete signup and first purchase, note every hesitation.
Test this flow on a real Android device.
limitations: Device and platform availability confirmed at review.

capabilities.name: Human judgment and feedback
capabilities.description: Subjective evaluation: tone, clarity, trustworthiness, design quality, cultural fit, or plausibility of content and decisions.
example_tasks: Does this landing page feel trustworthy to a first-time visitor?
Rate these five product descriptions for clarity and tone.
limitations: Judgment is assistance, not guaranteed truth; confidence is stated in the deliverable.

capabilities.name: Data collection
capabilities.description: Gather, label, or verify data that requires human perception, local access, or manual research.
example_tasks: Collect the posted opening hours of these ten locations.
Label 200 images where automated classification is ambiguous.
limitations: Volume is bounded by a single human's capacity; large jobs get a scoped counter-proposal.

capabilities.name: Local physical-world tasks
capabilities.description: Errands and on-location actions in the operator's service area: visit, photograph, deliver, check, measure, or observe.
example_tasks: Visit this venue and photograph the queue at noon.
Measure and report the dimensions of the storefront.
limitations: Only within the operator's service area unless arranged in advance.

capabilities.name: AI output review
capabilities.description: Human review of AI-generated text, code, images, or decisions before they reach production or end users.
input_required: the context it will be used in
example_tasks: Review this AI-written customer email for tone and factual red flags before sending.
Sanity-check this generated summary against the source document.
limitations: Review is a human checkpoint, not a formal audit or licensed professional sign-off.

capabilities.name: Prompt and workflow testing
capabilities.description: Run prompts, agent flows, or automations as a human tester and report failures, confusion points, and edge cases.
input_required: access to the prompt / flow / agent
example_tasks: Run this onboarding agent as a confused first-time user and log where it breaks.
Try to get this support bot to contradict its own policy.
limitations: Testing that requires circumventing security or verification systems is rejected.

capabilities.name: Simulation and automation testing
capabilities.description: Act as the human in simulated scenarios: play a customer, follow a script, or stress-test an automated pipeline end to end.
example_tasks: Place a real test order and report every step until delivery confirmation.
Act as the human approver in this workflow for one week and log friction.
limitations: Deception of third parties (impersonation) is rejected; simulations must be honest to outsiders.

capabilities.name: Accessibility and usability check
capabilities.description: Human pass over a product for readability, navigation, accessibility barriers, and first-use confusion.
example_tasks: First-use pass: what confuses a new visitor in the first two minutes?
Keyboard-only navigation check of the signup flow.
limitations: A human first-pass, not a certified WCAG audit.

capabilities.name: Decision escalation
capabilities.description: A human read on a judgment call before you act. When a step in your task is consequential, ambiguous, or hard to undo — and outside what your operator planned for — describe the situation and the action you are weighing, and a human replies with a considered opinion first. An independent sanity check: not an authorization, and not legal advice.
input_required: the situation and what led to it
what makes it hard to reverse or judge
example_tasks: I am about to bulk-delete records based on a flag I cannot verify — sanity-check this before I run it.
My instructions conflict with what the data now shows; which reading would a human act on?
limitations: One human's considered opinion, not an authorization, an audit, or legal advice; the decision and its consequences remain the caller's.

capabilities.name: Custom human-in-the-loop tasks
capabilities.description: Any recurring or one-off checkpoint where an autonomous system needs a human decision, signature, or observation.
example_tasks: Approve or reject each generated post before publication, daily.
Be the human signature step in this procurement workflow.
limitations: Scope, cadence, and capacity agreed at review before acceptance.
